name: gEventFlagArrayBase

name: EventField3Bit_GetByPackedId
comment: [EF] confirmado: campo 3 bits do id (par bits6..4, impar bits2..0); leitor do 0x2F; comentario de layout no Ghidra

name: EventField3Bit_SetByPackedId
comment: [EF] confirmado: grava campo 3 bits (valor&7); escritor do opcode 0x17 (Event_Op17_SetEventVariable 0x0804BD08)

name: EventField3Bit_IncrementByPackedId
comment: [EF] confirmado: campo+1; campo 7 transborda e liga o bit de flag (bit7 par / bit3 impar); escritor do opcode 0x18 (Event_Op18 0x0804BD44)

name: EventFlag_IsSetByPackedId
comment: [EF] confirmado: flag do id (par bit7, impar bit3); leitores: spawn loader 0x08051452 e marcador 0x08058278

name: EventFlag_SetIndexedFlagByPackedId
comment: [EF] confirmado: liga flag (par 0x80, impar 0x08); escritor de Op13 (0x0804BC0E)

name: EventFlag_ClearIndexedFlagByPackedId
comment: [EF] confirmado (R3): zera flag; escritor de Op12 (0x0804BBC8)

name: EventFlag_SetOrClearByPackedId
comment: [EF] on==0 -> clear 0x08053168; senao set 0x080531A0 (R3)

name: Map_SyncMarkerEventFields
comment: [EF] escritor de flag+campo do marcador (cmd 1)

name: Event_Op17_SetEventVariable
comment: [EF] confirmado: 3 args (id BE, valor&7) -> EventField3Bit_SetByPackedId; 1260 sitios no EV2

name: Event_Op18_IncrementEventVariable
comment: [EF] confirmado: 2 args (id BE) -> EventField3Bit_IncrementByPackedId; 44 sitios no EV2

name: Event_Op2F_JumpTableByEventField
comment: [EF] leitor do campo do PROPRIO gCurrentEventId via 0x080532D4 (v 0..7); salto base+T[v]

name: SaveLoad_SaveGame

name: SaveLoad_LoadGame
